description: A Flutter widget representing the calculator screen for the simple calculator app. It manages the UI layout, user interactions, and communicates with the calculator engine to perform calculations.

classes.name: CalculatorScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that displays the calculator UI and manages user interactions.

classes.name: _CalculatorScreenState
classes.description: State class for CalculatorScreen, manages the UI state, user inputs, and interacts with CalculatorEngine.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes the state and syncs it with the calculator engine.

methods.name: _syncFromEngine
methods.description: Updates the display input and result from the calculator engine state.

methods.name: onKeyPressed
methods.description: Handles user key presses, applies the corresponding calculator key to the engine, and updates UI.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the Flutter widget tree for the calculator screen, including display and keypad.
